svg.title: Supper plan domain: Tonight states, Weekly Planner, Portions and Groceries (Era 3)
svg.desc: Layer 3A Supper Plan domain board for WFS Family Cookbook Era 3.
svg.text: WFS / Shared Table · Family Cookbook Era 3
Shared meal-plan continuity from Home (Tonight) through Weekly Planner, Portions & Groceries.
Part 1 · Tonight on Home (state first, action second, consequence alongside)
Ready GOTO leads with Make this tonight.
• Search opens recipe selection (Suggestions on Mystery).
• Take Out records a plan (incl. delivery), not an order.
• Ready GOTO leads with Make this tonight above
side-by-side Search + Take Out; QuickCapture below.
• Note: QuickCapture adopts >= 12px copy in Wave C.
• Not shipped as a separate Home card.
• Explicit save feedback required before presenting as planned.
• Top row: context label + blush Ready in pill (sentence case).
• Food-led 5:4 photo + confident Outfit recipe title.
• Side-by-side Cook + Change plan row (wraps only at 200%).
• Cook opens Cook’s Mode; does not mark the meal cooked.
• Change plan: backup → original disposition → replacement save.
• Quiet View ingredients disclosure loads dated projection.
An intentional supper plan (not an external order)
Recipe marked as cooked (Dismiss compacts to badge)
Alongside tonight · Family voting (VotingNudgeCard — Target Era 3, Wave C)
Menu’s In: matches ready to review (not saved). Vote Now → Discover · See your matches → Planner.
Part 2 · Weekly Planner, inline Portions & Groceries (protected work)
Family note shown · tap to edit NonCooking sheet
Unconfirmed saves keep Review; dirty leaves warn first:
Compact [4] button resets override to usual count.
Guard: Save & continue · Keep editing · Discard
Already cooked past days stay visibly read-only.
Source title loading/failed states stay explicit;
aisle progress uses tonal sage-50 / garden-ink.
Home, Weekly Planner & Groceries stay bound to one authoritative deployment calendar.
